description: This file contains utility functions for the SCSSPHP project, including range checking, URI encoding, and multibyte string handling.

classes.name: Util
classes.description: A class providing utility functions for range validation, string encoding, and multibyte string operations.

methods.name: checkRange
methods.description: Checks if a value falls within a specified range, considering floating-point errors.

methods.name: encodeURIComponent
methods.description: Encodes a string as a URI component.

methods.name: mbChr
methods.description: Returns a multibyte character for a given Unicode code point.

methods.name: mbStrlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string in characters, supporting multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mbSubstr
methods.description: Returns a substring of a string, supporting multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mbStrpos
methods.description: Finds the position of the first occurrence of a substring in a string, supporting multibyte encodings.
